description: All-in-one marketing platform for sales funnels, email marketing, and online courses with a public API.
auth_notes: API key generated from user profile settings, passed via request header or parameter.
credential_notes: Any developer can sign up for a free systeme.io account and generate an API key from their profile settings.
api_notes: Covers core elements like contacts, tags, and automation/funnel resources.
mcp_notes: No official MCP server published by systeme.io.
rationale: Systeme.io offers a public REST API with self-serve API keys obtainable via a free account.
